pro_1.text: High above the clouds lies Aksharpur, where words keep the whole world alive.

pro_2.text: Every time someone reads, the great Story Tree grows a shining new leaf.

pro_3.text: But one little cloud had never, ever heard a story.

pro_4.text: Hee hee! Sounds, letters, words... now they're all mine!

pro_5.text: Oh no, oh no! The colours are gone, and the Story Tree is fading!

pro_6.text: You came! A real Explorer! Will you help me bring the words back?

pro_7.text: And so, the Quest for the Lost Words began.

sb_1.text: Look! The Star Bridge has appeared over the islands!

sb_2.text: Hee... you played through all seven islands? Then I have some riddles for you!

sb_3.text: Ready, Explorer? Let's show Gumsum everything you've learned!

so_1.text: A new season begins in Aksharpur.

so_2.text: You're really getting good at this. Maybe... reading isn't only for others?

so_3.text: Look, the islands are growing! New adventures are waiting for us!

g_warm.text: Let's try a warm-up one together.

g_chapter.text: Chapter complete! The island is growing!

beat_forest_0.text: Tinku's tabla has gone silent! Can you wake it up with the right sounds?

beat_forest_1.text: Koyal has lost her song. Listen closely and help her find it!

beat_forest_2.text: Gajju's drum is fast asleep. Every right sound gives it a beat!

beat_forest_3.text: Welcome to the Echo Cave. Every sound bounces back... listen carefully!

beat_forest_4.text: The fireflies dance to the rhythm. Let's give them one!

beat_forest_5.text: To cross the Rhyme River, step only on the stones that rhyme!

beat_forest_6.text: The Beat Bridge only holds when the sounds are right. Let's build it!

beat_forest_7.text: The bamboo is whispering sounds. Can you hear the words inside?

beat_forest_8.text: It's the midnight rehearsal! The band needs your sharpest ears.

beat_forest_9.text: Tonight is the Grand Jungle Concert! Lead the whole band, Maestro Explorer!

beat_valley_0.text: The first lantern of the festival is dark. Hit it with the right sound!

beat_valley_1.text: Garud's wind is blowing the lanterns around. Aim carefully!

beat_valley_2.text: These twin letters look alike. Listen, then choose!

beat_valley_3.text: The river lanterns are floating away. Light them before they go!

beat_valley_4.text: The festival gate opens only for the right letters.

beat_valley_5.text: Bolt crossed all the wires! Sounds and letters are mixed up.

beat_valley_6.text: The mountain echoes every sound. Which letters make it?

beat_valley_7.text: Time for the sky lantern parade! Let's light the whole sky!

beat_valley_8.text: Somewhere up there is the golden lantern. Find it with your best aim!

beat_valley_9.text: The Festival of Lights begins! Light every lantern in the valley!

beat_ocean_0.text: Bubbles and barnacles! The Bubble Rocket needs word fuel!

beat_ocean_1.text: Let's dive into the sunlight reef. Blend the sounds to steer!

beat_ocean_2.text: Coral's bridge is broken. Read the pieces to fix it!

beat_ocean_3.text: Strange signals from the twilight zone! Can you read them?

beat_ocean_4.text: A giant clam is guarding a pearl. Read the word to open it!

beat_ocean_5.text: The jellyfish light up when you read their names!

beat_ocean_6.text: Ping! The sonar shows words in the deep. Read them fast!

beat_ocean_7.text: We found a sunken ship! Its words are covered in sand.

beat_ocean_8.text: Down in the alien trench, creatures have the strangest names!

beat_ocean_9.text: The Pearl of Sounds is right below us! One last dive, Explorer!

beat_village_0.text: A mystery! Someone mixed up every word on the menu!

beat_village_1.text: Who switched the school sign? Find the right words to catch them!

beat_village_2.text: The bakery has a strange new sign. Let's investigate!

beat_village_3.text: Jugnu's night bazaar is dark. The right words will light it!

beat_village_4.text: The mangoes are missing! Follow the word clues!

beat_village_5.text: The post office letters are all jumbled. Sort them out, detective!

beat_village_6.text: The library has a riddle hidden in its words.

beat_village_7.text: Someone scribbled on the market map. Which words are real?

beat_village_8.text: The signboards are talking nonsense! Let's fix them!

beat_village_9.text: This is the biggest mystery in Word Village. Are you ready, detective?

beat_treasure_0.text: Our honeycomb is empty! Spell the words to fill it with honey.

beat_treasure_1.text: The baby bees are waiting to hatch. Every word helps one!

beat_treasure_2.text: Captain Kalam found his first rune! Spell it to open the chest.

beat_treasure_3.text: The pirate map is missing its words. Let's write them back!

beat_treasure_4.text: The queen needs honey words. Build them letter by letter!

beat_treasure_5.text: This chest is locked with a spelling lock!

beat_treasure_6.text: The waves keep washing away the words on Spelling Beach!

beat_treasure_7.text: Captain Kalam wrote a poem, but the parrot ate some letters!

beat_treasure_8.text: The treasure cave is full of word puzzles. Let's explore!

beat_treasure_9.text: The Golden Hive! Fill every cell, and the whole island will glow!

beat_castle_0.text: Kitabu forgot how his story begins! Can you read it with him?

beat_castle_1.text: The middle of this story has gone missing. Let's find it!

beat_castle_2.text: This ending ran away! Read carefully to bring it back.

beat_castle_3.text: We found a dragon's diary! What happened inside?

beat_castle_4.text: I have a riddle hidden in a story. Can you solve it?

beat_castle_5.text: The tower library is full of sleeping stories. Let's wake them!

beat_castle_6.text: The portraits are telling stories. Listen to what they say!

beat_castle_7.text: The secret staircase opens only for careful readers.

beat_castle_8.text: It's the midnight story hour. Every book is whispering!

beat_castle_9.text: The Great Story Restore! Bring back every ending in the castle!

beat_observatory_0.text: Let's map the stars of sounds!

beat_observatory_2.text: Can you connect the word stars?

beat_observatory_5.text: The Star Bridge gate is just ahead. One more star map!

how_soundOrchestra.text: Listen to the band, then pick the matching sound!

how_letterArcher.text: Hear the sound, then hit the matching letter!

how_wordRocket.text: Blend the sounds to power up the rocket!

how_wordDetective.text: Listen to the word, then find it among the look-alikes!

how_spellingHive.text: Hear the word, then build it with the honey tiles!

how_storyQuest.text: Read the little story, then answer the question!

how_starObservatory.text: Every star needs a different skill. Let's use them all!

det_intro_0.text: A mystery! Who took the mangoes from the market?

det_reveal_0.text: It was the goat! He just wanted a juicy snack. Case closed!

det_intro_1.text: A mystery! Who ate all the laddoos?

det_reveal_1.text: It was the little mouse! His tummy was rumbling. Case closed!

det_intro_2.text: A mystery! Who rang the temple bell at midnight?

det_reveal_2.text: It was the monkey! He wanted to make music. Case closed!

det_intro_3.text: A mystery! Who hid Arya's kite?

det_reveal_3.text: It was the parrot! He wanted to fly with it. Case closed!

det_intro_4.text: A mystery! Who splashed mud on the school wall?

det_reveal_4.text: It was the piglet! He was playing in the puddles. Case closed!

det_intro_5.text: A mystery! Who borrowed the library book?

det_reveal_5.text: It was the puppy! He wanted a bedtime story. Case closed!

det_accuse.text: Three clues! Now, detective, who did it?

det_think.text: Hmm… look at the clues again.
